name: privilege-review
description: Attorney-client privilege review of one document family: decides whether privilege holds, was waived by disclosure, or cannot be determined from the collected record.
goal: Decide whether the document family retains attorney-client privilege.

checks.name: waiver_by_disclosure
checks.description: a communication in the family was disclosed to a third party, waiving privilege

checks.name: non_legal_purpose
checks.description: the dominant purpose of the communications was not legal advice
